name: components_g4_fanmap
source:
// FanMap: pressure rise from a tabulated curve dP = map$(Q). The 1-D TABLE
// slopes 800 Pa at shutoff to 0 at 4 m^3/s; Q = 1.5 lands mid-span (500 Pa).
TABLE fdp(q)
  0    800
  4    0
END

FanMap FM(f1, f2, rho = 1.2, map$ = fdp)

f1.P    = 101325
f1.mdot = 1.8
dp_fan  = f2.P - f1.P
m_out   = f2.mdot
